import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
paths = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_68/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_68/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_68/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_68/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_68/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_68/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_68/training_6.csv",
]

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(p, index_col=0) for p in paths]

# Concatenate all source tables (UNION operation)
Target6_68 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
Target6_68['nombre'] = Target6_68['nombre'].astype(str)
Target6_68['n_concursados'] = Target6_68['n_concursados'].astype(int)
Target6_68['n_aprobados'] = Target6_68['n_aprobados'].astype(int)
Target6_68['año'] = Target6_68['año'].astype(int)

# Write the final target table to the specified path
Target6_68.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_68/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
